sloka: ये योधा निर्गताः शूरा राक्षसा मम शासनात्।ते सर्वे निहता युद्धे वानरैः सुमहाबलैः ।। ६.७२.८ ।।
transliteration: ye yodhā nirgatāḥ śūrā rākṣasā mama śāsanāt।te sarve nihatā yuddhe vānaraiḥ sumahābalaiḥ ।। 6.72.8 ।।

translations.english: " All those heroes who have gone by my order for combat, have been killed in the battle by mighty Vanaras."
